# Savings goals redesign

Lead: Customers set savings goals but rarely reached them. We redesigned goals around small, automatic steps.
Date: March 3, 2025
Locked: No
Outcome: Doubled the share of goals that reach 50% within three months.
Order: 6
Role: Lead UX/UI Designer
Client: Brightvale Bank (fictional)
Team: 1 PM, 3 engineers
Status: Launched 2025
Cover: Cover%20image.png

## Context

Savings goals were the most requested feature {and} the least used one. Only <10% of goals were ever completed.

![Goal overview on mobile](Savings%20goals%20redesign%203f2a9c1e8b7d4e6fa1b2c3d4e5f60718/Goal%20overview.png)

<aside>
💡 Most goals stalled after the first manual transfer.

</aside>

<aside>
🧭 **Decision: Automate the first step**
Instead of asking for an amount, the app proposes a weekly round-up that starts immediately.

</aside>
